summary: Replaced greedy slot picking with exact global meeting/room/occurrence assignment, prerequisite enforcement, final-timeline directed person setup checks, civil-time fold/gap resolution, and deterministic objective tie-breaking.
tests_run: Ran public.test.mjs and candidate.test.mjs via tests: 10 tests passed, 0 failed.
Compared 80 seeded schedules against an independent exhaustive complete-schedule oracle.

Validated DST folds/gaps, Lord Howe half-hour transitions, elapsed durations, dependencies, directed setup bridging, room blocks, global objectives, ASCII ties, range containment, and input preservation.
limitations: Exponential exact search is intended for at most 10 meetings and 3 rooms.
Civil-time resolution depends on Node Intl time-zone data and is scoped to the five specified zones in 2024–2026.
Inputs are assumed well formed; no live calendar integration is implemented or accessed.
